Use ONLY this data — no outside knowledge, no news. Tasks:

B) credibility: one sentence overall read on promise vs delivery.
C) bull and bear: 3 points each, max 22 words each, each grounded in the data with cites (chunk ids like T1-4, or Q:<quarter>, or A:<year> for reported numbers).

verdicts.evidence: EBITDA multiples target of 7.73 cannot be assessed from reported EBITDA or revenue figures.
Bridge financing interest rate of 4.1%-4.8% is not disclosed in the reported numbers.
Net Debt/EBITDA ratio is not provided, so the leverage guidance cannot be tested.
Transaction costs of Rs. 1,853.4 million incurred in Q2 FY27 indicate the Nagarro deal had not closed by early FY27 as guided.
Revenue rose each quarter from Q2 FY26 (₹3,581 Cr) to Q2 FY27 (₹4,664 Cr), but EBITDA margin fell from 19% to 14%.
Run‑rate in USD is not disclosed; rupee figures cannot be directly converted to the $500 million target.
Annual intangible spend amount is not reported, so the $8‑9 million guidance cannot be verified.
EBITDA margin was 16% in Q1 FY27 but dropped to 14% in Q2 FY27, below the 16‑17% target range.
Effective tax rate for FY26 is not provided; only the Q2 FY27 rate of 22.5% is available.

v.credibility: Management’s guidance was largely unmet or untestable, with key targets missed and many metrics undisclosed, indicating limited credibility.

bull.point: Consistent revenue acceleration from ₹3,062 Cr to ₹4,664 Cr over eight quarters shows strong top‑line growth.
